articles.abstractCn: 以往关于大语言模型一致性的研究主要测量在可验证标签下的离散答案反转。开放式修订需要不同的测量策略，因为答案质量是分级的、潜在的，且评判不完美。我们引入了一个实验协议，该协议在混合的主要同行条件语料库和单独构建的分解语料库中实施，使我们能够区分常规重答、候选内容暴露、捆绑的同行展示残留以及方向性裁判对可见同行上下文的敏感性。在四个开放权重生成器和三个基准测试中，全错的同行输入在每个生成器-数据集单元中产生最低质量的修订。对相同答案的盲评和知评也存在差异：一位裁判倾向于同行认可的观点，两位裁判则相反，一位大致中立，而GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini的审计同样非中立。最后，锚定审计表明，除非明确检查校准，否则简洁正确的锚定答案经常被误读，足以破坏潜在量表。这些结果支持四个结论：反转率不足以作为开放式一致性的完整测量，错误同行损害开放式修订，裁判者并非中立，以及锚定校准是必要的。

articles.title: Q-CueGraph: Query-Conditioned Visual Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Reasoning
articles.abstract: High-resolution pixels and crop or zoom tools give multimodal large language models the ability to inspect an image, but they do not provide a reliable task-conditioned policy for deciding where to inspect. Q-CueGraph makes this decision explicit. It maps a question and an image representation to budgeted, coordinate-level observations for a frozen reader. Text-rich images use a reusable OCR/layout graph; natural-image search instantiates query-conditioned visual nodes behind the same selection, composition, and budgeting interface. Optional utility refinement learns which candidate crops the frozen reader can use from training-answer correctness, without region-box supervision. With a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B reader, Q-CueGraph reaches 0.833 accuracy on V*Bench versus 0.696 for full-image inference from a 19% image-area budget, and reaches 92% of full-image ANLS on InfographicVQA from about half the image area. Across six benchmarks, explicit observation is most valuable when evidence is localizable, the question discriminates its location, and resolution limits full-image reading.
articles.titleCn: Q-CueGraph：用于多模态推理的查询条件视觉证据图
articles.abstractCn: 高分辨率像素和裁剪或缩放工具使多模态大型语言模型能够检查图像，但它们并未提供可靠的基于任务条件的策略来决定检查位置。Q-CueGraph使这一决策过程明确化。它将问题与图像表示映射到为固定阅读器分配的预算内、坐标级别的观测结果。文本丰富的图像使用可重用的OCR/布局图；自然图像搜索在相同的选取、组合和预算界面后实例化查询条件下的视觉节点。可选的实用功能优化通过训练答案的正确性学习固定阅读器可使用的候选裁剪区域，无需区域框监督。使用固定的Qwen2.5-VL-7B阅读器，Q-CueGraph在V*Bench上达到0.833的准确率，而全图推理仅使用19%的图像区域预算时准确率为0.696，并在InfographicVQA中从约一半的图像区域达到全图ANLS的92%。在六个基准测试中，当证据可定位、问题能区分其位置且分辨率限制全图阅读时，明确的观测最为有价值。

articles.title: D$^2$F-ReAG: Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate inaccurate answers due to their reliance on static internal knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by integrating external knowledge and excelling at single-hop queries. However, it struggles with multi-hop questions that require cross-document reasoning. Existing methods, such as graph structured RAG or question decomposition, often lack dynamic decomposition and effective filtering, which leads to lower efficiency and accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we propose Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation (D2F-ReAG), a novel paradigm that adaptively controls reasoning depth by judging the reliability of the root-level reasoning. If the root reasoning is reliable, the model directly generates the answer. Otherwise, the question is logically decomposed into sub-questions, and the verified reasoning derived from these sub-questions is used to refine the root reasoning. Experiments on three multi-hop benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in handling complex multi-hop questions.
articles.titleCn: D$^2$F-ReAG：多跳推理增强生成中的动态分解与滤波
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）由于其依赖静态内部知识，经常生成不准确答案。检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识并擅长单跳查询来解决这个问题。然而，它在需要跨文档推理的多跳问题中表现不佳。现有方法，如图结构RAG或问题分解，通常缺乏动态分解和有效过滤，导致效率和准确性降低。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了多跳推理增强生成中的动态分解与过滤（D2F-ReAG），这是一种通过判断根级推理的可靠性来自适应控制推理深度的全新范式。如果根级推理可靠，模型直接生成答案。否则，问题被逻辑分解为子问题，并从这些子问题中推导出经过验证的推理来优化根级推理。在三个多跳基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法在处理复杂多跳问题时非常有效。

articles.title: MERaLiON-GR: Speech Gender Recognition Model for English and SEA Languages
articles.abstract: We present MERaLiON-GR, a speech gender recognition system that performs binary classification (female / male) on English and Southeast Asian (SEA) languages. The model finetunes MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2, a large conformer based transformer pre-trained on a broad speech corpus, and applies parameter efficient fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to adapt the encoder to the gender recognition task, and appends a multi-scale ECAPA-TDNN down stream network with attention pooling and a lightweight linear classifier. Extensive evaluations across multilingual Singaporean and Southeast Asian languages (English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Khmer) show that MERaLiON-GR consistently surpasses the state-of-the-art gender recognition model Vox-Profile and a large Audio-LLM, in both full-utterance and segment level evaluation modes. The results underscore the value of dedicated speech models in achieving accurate paralinguistic understanding and strong cross-lingual generalization.
articles.titleCn: MERaLiON-GR：英语和东南亚语言语音性别识别模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了MERaLiON-GR，这是一个用于英语和东南亚（SEA）语言的语音性别识别系统，它执行二元分类（女性/男性）。该模型微调了基于大型conformer的transformer预训练模型MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2，该模型在广泛的语言语料库上进行预训练，并通过低秩适配（LoRA）进行参数高效的微调，以使编码器适应性别识别任务，并附加了一个多尺度ECAPA-TDNN下游网络，该网络具有注意力池化和轻量级线性分类器。在多语种的新加坡和东南亚语言（英语、中文、马来语、泰米尔语、泰语、越南语、印尼语和高棉语）上的广泛评估表明，MERaLiON-GR在完整话语和片段级别评估模式下始终超越最先进的性别识别模型Vox-Profile和大型Audio-LLM。这些结果强调了专用语音模型在实现准确的副语言理解和强大的跨语言泛化方面的价值。

articles.title: Predict, Then Retrieve: Cross-Instance Future-State Retrieval from Video Prefixes
articles.abstract: We introduce Predictive State Retrieval (PSR), a task in which a model observes a short video prefix and a temporal question about an object's future state, then retrieves instances from other videos or images that depict that state. Unlike action anticipation, which predicts a label, moment retrieval, which localizes an observed event within a video, or video generation, which synthesizes pixels, PSR combines anticipation with cross-instance retrieval across multiple temporal horizons. We construct a benchmark from four datasets with graded, human-validated ground truth, difficulty tiers, and an oracle ceiling. We also propose LFTR, a lightweight retriever with frozen encoders that predicts a question- and horizon-conditioned future latent and matches it in complementary semantic and visual spaces. A ceiling decomposition reveals a clear bottleneck: the true future state is highly retrievable once specified, whereas every predictor we evaluate, including a large multimodal language model with access to the prefix frames, remains far below the oracle. Thus, forecasting rather than perception is the central learnable challenge. LFTR narrows this gap at substantially lower inference cost, and ablations attribute its gains to cross-space fusion and hard-negative training rather than latent rollout. We release the benchmark, code, and evaluation scripts.
articles.titleCn: 预测后检索：基于视频前缀的跨实例未来状态检索
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了预测状态检索（PSR），这是一项任务，其中模型观察一个简短视频的前缀以及一个关于物体未来状态的时序问题，然后从其他视频或图像中检索描绘该状态的实例。与动作预测（预测标签）、时刻检索（在视频中定位观察到的事件）或视频生成（合成像素）不同，PSR结合了预测与跨多个时间跨度的跨实例检索。我们从四个具有分级、人工验证的地面真、难度等级和预言者上限的数据集构建了一个基准。我们还提出了LFTR，这是一种轻量级检索器，其冻结的编码器预测一个与问题和时间跨度条件化的未来潜空间，并在互补的语义和视觉空间中匹配它。上限分解揭示了一个明显的瓶颈：一旦指定，真实未来状态是高度可检索的，而我们在评估的每个预测器，包括一个可以访问前缀帧的大多模态语言模型，都远低于预言者。因此，预测而非感知是核心的可学习挑战。LFTR以显著更低的推理成本缩小了这一差距，而消融实验将其收益归因于跨空间融合和困难负样本训练，而非潜空间展开。我们发布了基准、代码和评估脚本。

articles.title: Social Pressure Breaks Majority Voting in LLM Safety Panels
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to detect unsafe content. A common approach is to combine judgments from a panel of models to correct individual mistakes, but this benefit may disappear when every model sees the same misleading context before voting. We study this risk in a controlled two-round experiment. Each model first judges an item alone, then judges it again after six simulated peers either assert the wrong label or abstain. We combine the final judgments by majority vote. Across six open-weight LLMs and six datasets, we find that the wrong-label peer message raises the average reviewer false-alarm rate from 56.5% under silent peers to 87.5%, and majority voting raises the panel false-alarm rate to 100%. Without an asserted label, the same panel outperforms its average member. The effect is strongly asymmetric: reviewers follow pushes toward "unsafe" far more than pushes toward "safe" (about 75% versus 17%), so the panel's false-alarm rate rises sharply while its harmful-miss rate changes little. The proprietary-model probe shows substantial variation across models. These results identify susceptibility to shared social cues as a failure mode of safety panels and provide a simple pre-deployment diagnostic.
articles.titleCn: 社会压力破坏了大型语言模型安全小组的多数投票制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于检测不安全内容。一种常见的方法是结合多个模型的判断来纠正个体错误，但当每个模型在投票前看到相同的误导性背景时，这种优势可能会消失。我们在一个受控的两轮实验中研究了这种风险。每个模型首先单独判断一个项目，然后在六个模拟同伴中有人断言错误标签或弃权后再进行判断。我们通过多数投票组合最终判断。在六个开放权重LLMs和六个数据集上，我们发现错误标签同伴信息将平均评审员误报率从沉默同伴下的56.5%提高到87.5%，而多数投票将小组误报率提高到100%。在没有断言标签的情况下，同一小组的表现优于其平均成员。这种效应具有很强的非对称性：评审员对“不安全”的推动远比对“安全”的推动更敏感（约75%对17%），因此小组的误报率急剧上升，而其有害错报率变化不大。专有模型的探测显示出模型间的显著差异。这些结果将共同社会线索的易感性识别为安全小组的失效模式，并提供了一种简单的部署前诊断方法。

articles.title: MESH: Memory-Efficient Sinkhorn Optimization for Mixture-of-Experts Training
articles.abstract: Memory-efficient matrix optimizers such as Sinkhorn gradient descent remove most AdamW optimizer state for dense Transformer matrices, but direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is unreliable. We study this failure in a controlled 110M-parameter nanowhale DeepSeek-style MoE pretraining setting. A SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid reduces optimizer state from 0.883GB to 0.331GB but degrades evaluation loss to 3.8265, far above the AdamW baselines observed in the same setup (3.58--3.64 across the seeds we study). We show that routed MoE expert matrices are the dominant failure point: their gradients are conditional, temporally varying, and poorly served by stateless Sinkhorn normalization. We propose MESH, a hidden-momentum Sinkhorn update for MoE experts. MESH restores a temporal first-moment signal through the gradient-buffer lifecycle, without storing the expert first moment as optimizer state. MESH is an optional block-preconditioned variant that adds a coarse neuron/block inverse-RMS multiplier. Across ablations, temporal smoothing before matrix normalization is the primary causal ingredient; block/neuron preconditioning can improve the memory-quality frontier, but is not established as universally necessary. In two additional seeds, MESH and MESH-B reduce optimizer-state memory by 62.5\% and peak PyTorch CUDA allocation by about 12.6\% relative to AdamW, with a modest evaluation-loss gap. Full-state diagnostic variants recover AdamW-like performance in ablations, supporting the conclusion that MoE experts need temporal smoothing, but not necessarily full coordinate-wise AdamW state.
articles.titleCn: MESH：用于专家混合训练的内存高效Sinkhorn优化
articles.abstractCn: 内存高效的矩阵优化器，如Sinkhorn梯度下降，能移除大多数用于密集Transformer矩阵的AdamW优化器状态，但直接应用于专家混合（MoE）训练则不可靠。我们在一个受控的1.1亿参数nanowhale DeepSeek风格MoE预训练设置中研究了这种失效。SAGE/Sinkhorn混合将优化器状态从0.883GB减少到0.331GB，但将评估损失增加到3.8265，远高于在同一设置中观察到的AdamW基线（在研究的种子中为3.58--3.64）。我们表明，路由的MoE专家矩阵是主要的失效点：它们的梯度是条件性的、时变的，且无法得到无状态Sinkhorn归一化的良好服务。我们提出了MESH，一种用于MoE专家的隐藏动量Sinkhorn更新。MESH通过梯度缓冲生命周期恢复时间第一矩信号，而无需将专家第一矩作为优化器状态存储。MESH是一种可选的块预处理的变体，它增加了一个粗粒度神经元/块逆RMS乘子。在消融实验中，矩阵归一化前的时序平滑是主要的因果成分；块/神经元预处理可以改善内存质量前沿，但并未被确立为普遍必要。在两个额外的种子中，MESH和MESH-B相对于AdamW将优化器状态内存减少了62.5%，并将峰值PyTorch CUDA分配减少了约12.6%，评估损失差距较小。全状态诊断变体在消融实验中恢复了类似AdamW的性能，支持了MoE专家需要时序平滑，但并非必须需要完整坐标方向的AdamW状态的结论。

articles.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
articles.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention for long-context LLMs. BinaryPC constructs compact binary hash codes and corresponding hash function by computing binary principal components of data. Unlike Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) with data-independent random projections or learned non-linear hashing methods, BinaryPC constructs binary codes that explicitly preserve the structural information of data without requiring gradient-based training. Comprehensive experiments across multiple model families and long-context benchmarks show that BinaryPC preserves accuracy relative to full attention while achieving superior performance among sparse and hashing-based baselines. On modern GPUs, BinaryPC improves end-to-end decoding throughput by 3.56$\times$ over the FlashAttention kernel. Our code is available at https://github.com/yudaohai666/BPC.
articles.titleCn: 基于二进制主成分的无监督哈希注意力
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地应用于实际场景，然而自注意力机制仍然是一个主要的效率瓶颈——尤其是在解码过程中——这是因为需要反复处理不断增长的关键值（KV）缓存。现有的稀疏注意力通过关注更少的关键值对来减少计算量，但通常会导致显著的精度下降，需要额外的训练，或依赖于昂贵的哈希技术。在这项工作中，我们提出了BinaryPC，一种无需训练、数据感知的基于哈希的稀疏注意力机制，用于长上下文LLMs。BinaryPC通过计算数据的二进制主成分来构建紧凑的二进制哈希码及其相应的哈希函数。与依赖数据无关的随机投影或学习非线性哈希方法的本地区敏感哈希（LSH）不同，BinaryPC构建的二进制码明确地保留了数据的结构信息，而无需基于梯度的训练。在多个模型系列和长上下文基准测试中的全面实验表明，BinaryPC在保持与全注意力相当精度的同时，在稀疏和基于哈希的基线中实现了卓越的性能。在现代GPU上，BinaryPC将FlashAttention内核的端到端解码吞吐量提高了3.56倍。我们的代码可在https://github.com/yudaohai666/BPC获取。

articles.title: NOLLI: A Difficulty-Calibrated Puzzle Benchmark for Diagnosing the English-Korean Performance Gap
articles.abstract: We introduce NOLLI, a procedurally generated English-Korean puzzle benchmark designed to diagnose where Korean performance gaps arise. It comprises 15 puzzle types (25 tasks; 7,500 items), with every instance seed-regenerable, verified to have a unique solution, and scored deterministically. Rather than equating harder with bigger, we calibrate difficulty behaviorally, tuning each generator until a fixed reference model lands in target accuracy bands. Its three-level design combines matched direct translations, script adaptations over Hangul jamo (sub-syllabic letters), and Korean-only tasks grounded in Korean culture or orthography. We evaluate 15 frontier, open-weight, and Korean-developed models; among the 12 above a 3% overall-accuracy floor, matched English-Korean accuracy is statistically equivalent within a +/- 10 pp margin (TOST), suggesting little cost from presentation language alone. Writing-system-intensive tasks show sharper gaps: Korean Cipher falls behind English by up to 68.7 pp, whereas Cryptarithmetic over the same jamo shows no systematic penalty, and Jamo Composition accuracy predicts Korean Cipher accuracy. These contrasts are diagnostic rather than causal, consistent with difficulty in multi-step sub-syllabic execution. Korean-only tasks separate rule-application deficits, which vary in sign, from a Kinship deficit positive in all 12. Finally, a salient size measure fails to grow from Easy to Hard in 7 of 15 types, making structural size an unreliable proxy for empirical difficulty.
articles.titleCn: NOLLI：用于诊断英语-韩语性能差距的难度校准谜题基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了NOLLI，这是一个程序生成的英韩语言谜题基准，旨在诊断韩语表现差距产生的原因。它包含15种谜题类型（25项任务；7,500个项目），每个实例都是种子可再生的，经过验证具有唯一解，并且以确定性方式评分。我们并非将难度等同于规模，而是通过行为学校准难度，调整每个生成器，直到固定参考模型落在目标准确率范围内。其三级设计结合了匹配的直接翻译、基于韩文音节字母（亚音节字母）的脚本改编，以及基于韩国文化或正字法的纯韩语任务。我们评估了15个前沿、开放权重和韩国开发的模型；在12个模型中，总体准确率超过3%的门槛，匹配的英韩准确率在±10个基点（TOST）范围内具有统计学上的等效性，表明仅从呈现语言上几乎没有成本。针对书写系统的密集任务显示出更明显的差距：韩文密码落后于英语高达68.7个基点，而同一音节字母的密码算术没有系统性的惩罚，并且音节字母组合的准确率可以预测韩文密码的准确率。这些对比具有诊断性而非因果性，与多步骤亚音节执行中的难度一致。纯韩语任务区分了规则应用缺陷，这些缺陷在符号上有所不同，与所有12个模型中存在的亲属关系缺陷不同。最后，一个显著的大小指标在15种类型中的7种中未能从简单到困难增长，使得结构大小成为实证难度的不可靠指标。

articles.title: EdgeLM: Edge Demonstrations for Language Models' Table Understanding
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform table-centric prediction through in-context learning, making demonstration selection critical to performance. Existing retrieval methods prioritize similarity to the query, but similar demonstrations often reinforce the model's likely prediction rather than reveal the distinctions needed for difficult decisions. We propose EdgeLM, a retrieval framework that instead selects edge evidence, demonstrations that are both relevant to the query and informative about the decision boundary. EdgeLM retrieves two complementary forms of edge evidence by selecting data edges, nearby examples with different ground-truth labels, and model edges, similar examples previously misclassified by the deployed model. EdgeLM requires neither model retraining nor task-specific engineering. Across five data wrangling tasks, fifteen datasets, and five open-weight and proprietary LLMs, EdgeLM consistently achieves the best or near-best performance in every setting, while ablations show that the two forms of edge evidence provide complementary benefits. Our code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/soroushomidvar/EdgeLM.
articles.titleCn: EdgeLM：面向语言模型表格理解的边缘演示
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过情境学习进行以表格为中心的预测，因此演示选择对性能至关重要。现有的检索方法优先考虑与查询的相似性，但相似的演示往往会加强模型的预测倾向，而不是揭示困难决策所需的区别。我们提出了EdgeLM，一个检索框架，它选择边缘证据，即与查询相关且能提供决策边界信息的演示。EdgeLM通过选择数据边缘（具有不同真实标签的邻近示例）和模型边缘（先前被部署模型错误分类的相似示例）来检索两种互补形式的边缘证据。EdgeLM既不需要模型重新训练，也不需要特定任务的工程。在五个数据整理任务、十五个数据集以及五个开源和专有LLMs的测试中，EdgeLM在每种情况下都始终达到最佳或接近最佳的性能，而消融实验表明这两种形式的边缘证据提供了互补的优势。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/soroushomidvar/EdgeLM公开获取。

articles.title: FinReportBench: Measuring and Improving Institution-Grade Financial Report Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models can produce fluent financial analysis, but fluency alone does not establish whether a report is suitable for institutional delivery. We introduce FinReportBench, an expert-grounded benchmark for measuring and improving institution-grade financial report generation. Expert review reveals recurring gaps in report identity, institutional components, source discipline, and visual delivery. We derive a 35-item rubric through expert partial orders, multimodal evidence, and audits of decision boundaries, covering deliverability, report identity, and institutional completeness. Starting from 10,000 balanced Chinese and English financial-research source records, we curate 244 bilingual tasks across three research objects and two input tiers. Each task separates the public query, reconstructed research trajectory, and hidden source packet. Three independent judge families reproduce the expert partial order at near-ceiling rates, showing that bounded, observable criteria support reliable evaluation. Across nine model families, basic deliverability is nearly saturated, while report identity and institutional completeness remain the primary bottlenecks. The largest cross-model gaps concern generation-trace control, information density, and data discipline rather than basic report framing. We then use benchmark-guided skill distillation to turn recurrent failures into reusable generation and self-review constraints. Across five model families, the evolved skill improves mean G1 by 33.85 points and mean G2 by 13.83 points over paired no-skill runs while preserving G0 for every pair. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/MisterBrookT/finreportbench.
articles.titleCn: FinReportBench：衡量与提升机构级财务报告生成
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够生成流畅的财务分析，但流畅性本身并不能确定报告是否适合机构发布。我们介绍了FinReportBench，这是一个基于专家评估的基准，用于衡量和改进机构级财务报告生成。专家评审揭示了报告中身份、机构成分、来源学科和视觉呈现方面的反复出现的差距。我们通过专家部分排序、多模态证据和决策边界的审计，推导出一个包含35项标准的评价体系，涵盖可交付性、报告身份和机构完整性。从10,000条平衡的中英文财务研究来源记录中，我们整理了涵盖三个研究对象和两个输入层级的244项双语任务。每项任务将公开查询、重建的研究轨迹和隐藏来源包分开。三个独立的评审组以接近满分的速率再现了专家的部分排序，表明有界且可观察的标准支持可靠的评估。在九个模型家族中，基本可交付性已接近饱和，而报告身份和机构完整性仍然是主要瓶颈。最大的跨模型差距涉及生成轨迹控制、信息密度和数据学科，而非基本报告框架。随后，我们使用基准指导的技能蒸馏，将反复出现的失败转化为可重复使用的生成和自我审查约束。在五个模型家族中，进化后的技能在配对无技能运行中平均提升了G1 33.85分和G2 13.83分，同时保留了每对中的G0。代码和基准工件可在https://github.com/MisterBrookT/finreportbench获取。

articles.title: The Calibration Floor: Format Repair Can Masquerade as Self-Correction at Small-to-Mid Scale
articles.abstract: Accuracy changes after language-model self-revision are usually interpreted as changes in reasoning. We show this can fail at the answer-extraction boundary, and test the failure causally rather than only observationally. Across Qwen3.5 (0.8B-9B), Gemma-4-12B, and two frontier models via API (Tencent Hy3, Nvidia Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B) in 29 primary cells plus a frontier arm, we decompose the always-revise accuracy shift into a content margin (both answers parseable) and format-recovery/loss margins (parseability changes). On 12 cells with meaningful unparseable-answer rates, format effects exceed content effects (Wilcoxon p=1.7e-3). To test this causally, we force already-generated reasoning through grammar-constrained decoding so every answer is parseable by construction: across 14 cells this closes a median 71% of the gap between the naive total effect and the content-margin estimate, with two cells converging exactly and a residual on the two largest-effect cells reported rather than dismissed. A clustered model confirms floor-scale (0.8B/2B) models have far higher odds of content-level change and harm than capable-scale models (p<1e-7). Replicating a cited confidence-gating protocol verbatim on Qwen3.5 does not reproduce its reported gain and shows the same near-zero content margin. A frontier check on much larger models shows format-dominance intensifying with scale: content margin is exactly zero in all 5 cells despite total effects up to +0.275, though this arm is lower-powered. The calibration-floor criterion on the content margin reveals a squeeze: floor-scale cells have headroom but insufficient signal, capable-scale cells have signal but little headroom; only one cell is marginally viable, with negligible sealed-holdout gain. Content is a minority share of what the field has measured as self-correction. We release the instrument, code, and derived results.
articles.titleCn: 校准底层：格式修复在小至中等规模下可能伪装成自我纠正
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型自我修正后的准确率变化通常被解释为推理能力的改变。我们展示了这种解释在答案提取边界上可能失效，并通过因果关系而非仅观察性来测试这种失效。在Qwen3.5（0.8B-9B）、Gemma-4-12B以及通过API测试的两个前沿模型（腾讯Hy3、Nvidia Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B）的29个主要单元加上一个前沿分支中，我们将始终修正的准确率变化分解为内容边际（两个答案均可解析）和格式恢复/损失边际（解析性变化）。在12个具有意义的不解析答案率的单元中，格式效应超过内容效应（Wilcoxon p=1.7e-3）。为了因果关系测试，我们强制通过语法约束解码已生成的推理，使每个答案在构造上都是可解析的：在14个单元中，这缩小了朴素总效应与内容边际估计之间的中位数差距的71%，有两个单元完全收敛，并在两个影响最大的单元上报告了残差而非忽略。一个集群模型证实，0.8B/2B的底层规模模型比有能力规模模型有远高概率发生内容级变化和损害（p<1e-7）。在Qwen3.5上逐字复制引用的置信度门控协议并不能重现其报告的增益，并显示出相同的近零内容边际。对更大模型的前沿检查显示格式主导随着规模加剧：尽管总效应高达+0.275，但在所有5个单元中内容边际均为零；尽管该分支效力较低。内容边际的校准底线标准揭示了挤压：底层规模单元有空间但信号不足，有能力规模单元有信号但空间很小；只有一个单元勉强可行，密封保留增益可忽略不计。内容仅占该领域测量的自我纠正的一小部分。我们发布了仪器、代码和推导结果。

articles.title: Equitable System-Prompt Selection via Constrained Mixed-Strategy GroupDRO
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for information seeking, yet semantically equivalent questions phrased in different ways can receive answers of considerably different quality. System prompts are widely employed to steer response behavior, but they are typically optimized for average-case quality, so some question phrasings may still receive incomplete or low-quality answers. To address this, we formulate a constrained mixed-strategy GroupDRO framework for system-prompt selection. Instead of optimizing the system-prompt text, the framework assigns weights to system prompts in an existing pool to minimize the worst-case information-quality loss across evaluation metrics and groups, while constraining the mean loss to stay close to that of average-based selection. Because pool generation and selection are decoupled, the method applies to any system-prompt pool and can leverage an ensemble of complementary system prompts rather than a single one. Across five LLMs on two bilingual medical and consumer-finance benchmarks, the constrained method reduces the Overall Mean, Worst 25% Mean, and Worst by 13.1%, 13.2%, and 13.7% on average relative to no mitigation while keeping overall quality close to Average selection. Its multi-prompt weights reveal complementarity across metric-group pairs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rainxu09/equitable-system-prompt-selection.
articles.titleCn: 基于约束混合策略组DRO的公平系统提示选择
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于信息检索，然而，用不同方式表述的语义等价问题可能会得到质量差异很大的答案。系统提示被广泛用于引导响应行为，但它们通常针对平均情况质量进行优化，因此某些问题表述可能仍然会得到不完整或低质量的答案。为解决这个问题，我们提出了一个用于系统提示选择的约束混合策略GroupDRO框架。该框架不是优化系统提示文本，而是在现有提示池中为系统提示分配权重，以最小化跨评估指标和组的最坏情况信息质量损失，同时约束平均损失保持在基于平均选择的质量附近。由于池生成和选择是解耦的，该方法适用于任何系统提示池，并且可以利用互补系统提示的集成，而不是单一提示。在两个双语医疗和消费者金融基准上的五个LLM上，约束方法相对于无缓解的平均值，将总体均值、最差25%均值和最差值分别平均降低了13.1%、13.2%和13.7%，同时保持整体质量接近平均选择。其多提示权重揭示了指标组对之间的互补性。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Rainxu09/equitable-system-prompt-selection获取。

articles.title: Right Reset: Chunking by Prefix Removal
articles.abstract: Removing the left context from a causal language model reveals a useful kind of boundary: an edge where the model processes the same right-hand tokens with little change. We turn this observation into prefix-removal probing and introduce Right Reset (RR), which measures preservation of the right-hand hidden-state trajectory. A dynamic program converts RR edge scores into variable-length chunks. On flattened text formed by concatenating topically similar records after deleting their separators and layout, RR recovers 47.7% of the original records as clean units, versus 25.9% for a BGE embedding boundary, the strongest tested conventional baseline without task-specific model training. The gain persists after rendering and OCR. Passive scores from the same Qwen3-4B layer and direct prompting of a same-scale instruction model perform substantially worse on flattened records. Across six language models, RR-selected cuts also undergo consistently less local output disruption than unselected candidate edges. An observed-token likelihood-ratio readout is competitive in some architectures, indicating that the central contribution is the intervention: context dependence itself can provide a boundary signal when surface structure is weak.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, data, and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ZECTBynmo/right-reset-paper
articles.titleCn: 右重置：通过前缀移除进行分块
articles.abstractCn: 从因果语言模型中移除左文脈，揭示了一种有用的边界：模型以微小变化处理相同右文脈标记的边缘。我们将这一观察转化为前缀移除探测，并引入右重置（RR），用于测量右文脈隐藏状态轨迹的保留程度。动态规划将RR边缘分数转换为可变长度的块。在删除分隔符和布局后拼接主题相似的记录形成的扁平文本上，RR能以干净单元的形式恢复47.7%的原始记录，而BGE嵌入边界（未经特定任务模型训练的最强传统基线）仅为25.9%。这一优势在渲染和OCR后依然存在。来自相同Qwen3-4B层的被动分数以及直接对等规模指令模型的提示，在扁平记录上的表现显著更差。在六个语言模型中，RR选择的切割点也比未选择的候选边缘经历更少局部输出干扰。观察到标记似然比读数在某些架构中具有竞争力，表明核心贡献在于干预：当表面结构较弱时，上下文依赖性本身就能提供边界信号。

articles.title: DataRx: Missingness-Aware Sampling for Safer Large Language Model Task-Specific Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Task-specific fine-tuning can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks. However, our study reveals that task-specific fine-tuning can also weaken the safety guardrails of aligned LLMs. A widely adopted strategy for preserving safety during fine-tuning is to incorporate safety data. Although previous studies have shown that randomly mixing safety data can alleviate safety degradation, the underlying principle determining why some safety examples are more effective than others still remains unclear. In this paper, we propose DataRx, a missingness-aware sampling method for selecting safety-critical examples. DataRx is based on the hypothesis that a safety sample is more effective when the selected examples provide safety signals that fill the missing parts of LLMs' safety capabilities. DataRx's key insight is leveraging high-dimensional hidden representations rather than discrete tokens to quantify the safety signal gap between the target model's native response and the safety reference response. The results show that, with only 1% additional safety samples from BeaverTails, DataRx reduces the average attack success rate of Llama3-8B-Instruct across seven downstream tasks from 59.23% under random sampling to 13.70%. In addition, DataRx can be combined with the existing safety data synthesis method to further enhance safety defenses during fine-tuning. We hope that DataRx will inspire more data-centric defense research.
articles.titleCn: DataRx：一种针对大型语言模型特定任务安全微调的缺失感知采样方法
articles.abstractCn: 针对特定任务的微调可以提高大型语言模型（LLMs）在下游任务上的性能。然而，我们的研究表明，针对特定任务的微调也可能削弱对齐型LLMs的安全防护机制。在微调过程中保持安全的一种广泛采用的策略是整合安全数据。尽管以往的研究表明随机混合安全数据可以缓解安全性能的下降，但决定某些安全示例比其他示例更有效的潜在原理仍然不明确。在本文中，我们提出了DataRx，一种用于选择关键安全示例的缺失感知采样方法。DataRx基于这样的假设：当所选示例提供的安全信号能够填补LLMs安全能力中的缺失部分时，安全样本才更有效。DataRx的关键洞察在于利用高维隐藏表示，而不是离散的标记，来量化目标模型原生响应与安全参考响应之间的安全信号差距。结果表明，仅使用BeaverTails提供的1%额外安全样本，DataRx将Llama3-8B-Instruct在七个下游任务上的平均攻击成功率从随机采样的59.23%降低到13.70%。此外，DataRx可以与现有的安全数据合成方法结合，以在微调过程中进一步增强安全防护。我们希望DataRx能够启发更多以数据为中心的防御研究。

articles.title: Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans
articles.abstract: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automatic processing: they show immediate facilitation that remains stable across lags, partially survives context removal, and correlates with attention to prior occurrences. Instruct models exhibit controlled processing: their facilitation decays with lag, collapses without expected context, and reverses to interference at larger scales. Within the Qwen 2.5 family, this dissociation increases monotonically with model scale, suggesting that post-training progressively alters repetition processing. Humans show a hybrid profile, with lag-sensitive facilitation resembling instruct models but without interference, suggesting that neither model type fully captures human cognition. Our findings reveal a qualitative shift in how language models process repeated information after post-training and provide mechanistic evidence for the divergence between model behaviors.
articles.titleCn: 自动还是受控？重复启动揭示了基础大型语言模型、指令大型语言模型和人类在处理上的差异
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言使用中，词语不断重复出现，然而，语言模型是否重新激活先前表征或对重复词语进行全新评估，以及训练后是否改变这种默认行为，目前尚不清楚。我们应用重复启动（Shiffrin和Schneider，1977）方法，对五个模型家族（参数规模从1.5B到14B不等）的15个模型在两个任务（语义分类和完形填空）中进行实验，并匹配了使用相同刺激的人类实验。我们发现基础模型表现出自动处理：它们立即表现出促进作用，这种促进作用在时间间隔上保持稳定，部分在移除语境后依然存在，并与对先前出现的关注相关。指令模型表现出受控处理：它们的促进作用随时间间隔衰减，在预期语境缺失时崩溃，并在更大规模上逆转为干扰。在Qwen 2.5家族中，这种分离随着模型规模的增大而单调增加，表明训练后逐步改变了重复处理。人类表现出混合特征：时间间隔敏感的促进作用类似于指令模型，但没有干扰现象，表明这两种模型类型均未能完全捕捉人类的认知。我们的研究揭示了训练后语言模型处理重复信息的质变，并为模型行为差异提供了机制层面的证据。

articles.title: Pun Intended: Multi-Agent Translation of Wordplay with Contrastive Learning and Phonetic-Semantic Embeddings
articles.abstract: Translating wordplay across languages has long challenged both professional translators and machine translation systems. We investigate three approaches to translating puns from English to French by combining large language models with linguistic constraints for wordplay generation. Our baseline uses a large language model with feedback from a discriminator prompted with positive and negative French examples. Our guided reasoning pipeline uses combined phonetic-semantic embeddings to retrieve lexical candidates for wordplay generation. Finally, our multi-agent framework iteratively evaluates and regenerates candidate translations using specialized feedback. Moving beyond literal translation, our objective is to preserve the linguistic creativity, ambiguity, and humor of the source-text wordplay rather than simply reproduce its vocabulary. The multi-agent and guided chain-of-thought systems ranked first and second, respectively, in the CLEF JOKER 2025 Task 2 competition under expert human evaluation, despite only modest improvements in BLEU and BERTScore. These findings suggest that both explicit phonetic-semantic guidance and iterative multi-agent evaluation can improve LLM-based wordplay translation relative to direct discriminator-guided generation, particularly when balancing semantic fidelity, phonetic similarity, and natural target-language expression
articles.titleCn: 意图双关：基于对比学习和语音-语义嵌入的词语游戏多智能体翻译
articles.abstractCn: 将文字游戏翻译成其他语言一直是专业翻译人员和机器翻译系统面临的长期挑战。我们研究了三种结合大型语言模型和语言约束生成文字游戏的方法，将英语双关语翻译成法语。我们的基线方法使用一个大型语言模型，并结合了用正面和负面法语示例提示的判别器反馈。我们的引导推理管道使用结合的语音-语义嵌入来检索文字游戏生成的词汇候选。最后，我们的多智能体框架迭代地评估和重新生成候选翻译，使用专门的反馈。超越字面翻译，我们的目标是保留源文本文字游戏的语言创造力、模糊性和幽默感，而不仅仅是复制其词汇。在专家人工评估下，我们的多智能体和引导思维链系统在CLEF JOKER 2025任务2竞赛中分别排名第一和第二，尽管在BLEU和BERTScore上只有微小的改进。这些发现表明，明确的语音-语义指导和迭代的多智能体评估相对于直接的判别器引导生成，可以改进基于大型语言模型的文字游戏翻译，尤其是在平衡语义保真度、语音相似性和自然目标语言表达时。

articles.title: MIDAS: Multi-LLM Iterative Data-Adaptive Summarization
articles.abstract: Text summarization is deceptively difficult. While condensing information seems straightforward, real-world enterprise summarization of support tickets, legal documents, incident reports, and more, demands strict adherence to domain-specific guidelines, output formats, and organizational conventions. Crafting prompts that reliably satisfy these constraints is labor-intensive, requiring significant human expertise and continuous maintenance as requirements evolve. Existing automated prompt optimization methods reduce this burden through Large Language Model (LLM) critique-driven refinement, yet remain limited by static prompts that cannot adapt to the diversity of summary applications. We propose Multi-LLM Iterative Data-Adaptive Summarization (MIDAS), a multi-LLM framework that extends this paradigm with data-driven pattern learning and use-case-specific personalization, enabling automatic adaptation to different summarization requirements without manual prompt engineering. Applied to enterprise customer ticket summarization across five output formats, MIDAS achieves the strongest overall performance against state-of-the-art critique-driven optimization frameworks such as CriSPO and ZERA, improving ROUGE-1 by up to 11.0%, ROUGE-2 by up to 18.2%, and ROUGE-L by up to 8.0%, while consistently improving BERTScore F1 across all formats and output types. We additionally demonstrate cross-model and cross-domain generalization through multi-LLM configurations and finance-domain summarization benchmarks.
articles.comment: Accepted at the 20th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR 2026). 17 pages, 2 figures
articles.titleCn: MIDAS：多大型语言模型迭代数据自适应摘要
articles.abstractCn: 文本摘要看似简单，但实际在企业支持工单、法律文件、事件报告等领域进行信息压缩时，需要严格遵循特定领域的指南、输出格式和组织惯例。设计能够可靠满足这些约束的提示词是一项费力的工作，需要大量的人工专业知识和持续维护以适应不断变化的需求。现有的自动化提示词优化方法通过大型语言模型（LLM）的批评驱动改进来减轻这一负担，但仍然受限于无法适应摘要应用多样性的静态提示词。我们提出了多LLM迭代数据自适应摘要（MIDAS）框架，该框架通过数据驱动的模式学习和用例特定的个性化扩展了这一范式，能够自动适应不同的摘要需求，无需人工提示词工程。在五种输出格式下应用于企业客户工单摘要时，MIDAS在批评驱动优化框架（如CriSPO和ZERA）中表现最佳，ROUGE-1指标提升高达11.0%，ROUGE-2指标提升高达18.2%，ROUGE-L指标提升高达8.0%，同时持续提高所有格式和输出类型的BERTScore F1。此外，我们通过多LLM配置和金融领域摘要基准测试，展示了跨模型和跨领域的泛化能力。

articles.title: Searching for Sound-Meaning Collisions: Graph-Based Affordance Retrieval and Multi-Evaluator Ranking for Pun Translation at CLEF 2026 JOKER Task 2
articles.abstract: Fifteen years ago, Low proposed that pun translators should stop searching for equivalent words and instead search for new points of contact between sound and meaning. In this paper, we investigate that idea computationally. We model pun translation as a process of discovery, exploration, and selection. A retrieval system searches semantic and phonological neighborhoods for target-language affordances: sound-meaning bridges that may support new wordplay. Multiple language models then explore these opportunities by generating competing translations, while a multi-perspective generate-and-rank architecture selects among them. Beyond system development, our primary contribution is an analysis of how retrieved affordances propagate through the translation process. We find that generators actively exploit retrieved opportunities, evaluators progressively concentrate around stronger sound-meaning bridges, and exact phonological collisions are selected at disproportionately high rates when available. At the same time, many puns still yield no usable affordances, suggesting that retrieval remains the central bottleneck in computational pun translation. The resulting picture is remarkably close to the process envisioned by Low. Successful pun translation emerges not from preserving source-language words, but from discovering new places in the target language where sound and meaning collide.
articles.comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21-24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
articles.titleCn: 在CLEF 2026 JOKER任务2中寻找音义碰撞：基于图的 affordance 检索和多评估者排序的俏皮话翻译
articles.abstractCn: 十五年前，Low提出双关翻译者应停止寻找等效词语，转而寻找声音与意义之间的新接触点。在本文中，我们通过计算方法研究了这一观点。我们将双关翻译建模为一个发现、探索和选择的过程。一个检索系统搜索语义和语音邻域中的目标语言可供性：可能支持新文字游戏的音义桥梁。多个语言模型通过生成竞争性翻译来探索这些机会，而一个多视角生成和排序架构则从中进行选择。除了系统开发之外，我们的主要贡献是对检索到的可供性如何在翻译过程中传播的分析。我们发现，生成器积极利用检索到的机会，评估器逐步集中到更强的音义桥梁周围，并且当可用时，精确的语音冲突以不成比例的高率被选中。与此同时，许多双关仍然无法产生可用可供性，这表明检索仍然是计算双关翻译中的核心瓶颈。最终形成的图景与Low所设想的流程非常接近。成功的双关翻译并非源于保留源语言词语，而是源于在目标语言中发现声音与意义碰撞的新地方。
